# HelpMyIMG — Complete Technical Documentation & LLM Knowledge Graph (llms-full.txt)
# Canonical URL: https://helpmyimg.com/
# Last Updated: 2026-10-28

## 1. System Overview & Technology Stack
HelpMyIMG is an open, client-side image manipulation and computer vision platform engineered to eliminate server dependencies for modern photo editing workflows.

### Architectural Pillars:
1. **Runtime Execution:** Pure client-side JavaScript, TypeScript, WebAssembly (WASM), and WebGPU.
2. **Model Architecture:** Lightweight neural networks compiled for ONNX Runtime Web (`briaai/RMBG-1.4`, MODNet, DIS) running inside isolated HTML5 Web Workers to prevent UI thread blocking.
3. **Hardware Acceleration:** Automatic hardware selection:
   - Tier 1: WebGPU compute shaders for high-throughput tensor operations.
   - Tier 2: Multi-threaded WebAssembly with SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) vectorization.
   - Tier 3: Hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas & WebGL 2.0 fallback.
4. **Data Isolation:** All operations take place in volatile system RAM (`ArrayBuffer`, `Blob`, `OffscreenCanvas`). Zero data retention, zero network telemetry, zero server-side logging.

---

## 2. Comprehensive Tool Specifications

### 2.1 AI Background Eraser (Remove Background)
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-background/`
- **Underlying Engine:** ONNX WebAssembly Neural Network (RMBG-1.4 / Bi-directional Feature Pyramid Network).
- **Supported Input Formats:** JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, GIF.
- **Output Format:** 32-bit RGBA PNG with alpha transparency channel.
- **Resolution Support:** Native camera resolutions up to 8192x8192px without downscaling.
- **Batch Processing:** Sequential Web Worker pipeline; drops 50+ images, returns individual downloads or consolidated ZIP archive.
- **Execution Speed:** 150ms – 650ms per image on modern desktop GPUs; 800ms – 1800ms on mobile devices.

### 2.2 Precise Target Image Compressor
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image/`
- **Sub-Tools & Presets:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-100kb/` (Strict CPNS / Visa / Gov Portal constraint)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-50kb/` (Avatar, signature, and low-bandwidth constraint)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-200kb/` (E-commerce and standard web banner constraint)
- **Compression Algorithms:**
  - JPEG: Dual-pass binary search quality optimization with MozJPEG quantization.
  - PNG: Color palette reduction (8-bit indexed PNG via Floyd-Steinberg dithering).
  - WebP: Lossy arithmetic entropy encoding.
- **Metadata Handling:** Preserves or strips EXIF metadata on user demand.

### 2.3 Biometric Passport & ID Photo Studio
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/change-background/`
- **Specialized Presets:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/change-background-to-white/`
  - Indonesian Standard ID (KTP / CPNS): Red (`#DB1514`) for odd birth years, Blue (`#00529C`) for even birth years.
  - US / Schengen / UK Visa: Standard Studio White (`#FFFFFF`) with lighting balance.
  - Standard Sizes: 2x2 inch (US Passport), 35x45 mm (Schengen Visa), 3x4 cm, 4x6 cm.
- **Workflow:** One-click neural cutout followed by background vector color fill.

### 2.4 Dimension Scaling & Social Cropping
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image/`
- **Dedicated Slugs:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image-for-instagram/` (1:1 Square 1080x1080, 4:5 Portrait 1080x1350, 9:16 Story 1080x1920)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/crop-image/` (Freeform, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:2 aspect ratios)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/rotate-image/` (Lossless 90° rotation, arbitrary rotation, horizontal flip, vertical flip)
- **Interpolation Filter:** Lanczos3 / Bilinear high-fidelity resampling.

### 2.5 Multi-Format Image Converter
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/convert-image/`
- **Dedicated Slugs:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/convert-to-webp/`
- **Supported Matrix:**
  - Input: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, GIF, SVG, BMP, ICO.
  - Output: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, GIF.
- **Performance:** Instant transcoding via browser native image decoders and canvas context serialization.

### 2.6 Privacy Masking & Identity Redaction
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/blur-face/`
- **Dedicated Slugs:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/blur-license-plate/`
- **Mechanics:** Gaussian blur and pixelation filters applied selectively via automated bounding-box detection or manual canvas brush strokes.

### 2.7 Asset Branding & Watermark Engine
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/watermark-image/`
- **Dedicated Slugs:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/bulk-watermark/`
- **Features:** Alpha transparency control, full-canvas tiled diagonal watermarks, custom typography, image logo stamping.

### 2.8 Specialized Photo Manipulation
- **Magic Eraser / Brush:** `https://helpmyimg.com/magic-brush/` (Inpainting unwanted objects)
- **Logo Remover:** `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-logo/`
- **Person Remover:** `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-person/`
- **Color Extractor:** `https://helpmyimg.com/image-color-picker/` (Color eye-dropper with HEX/RGB/HSL readouts)
- **Advanced Photo Studio:** `https://helpmyimg.com/advanced-editor/` (Contrast, saturation, exposure, filters, drawing layers)

## 4. Privacy & Regulatory Compliance
- **GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679):** HelpMyIMG acts as neither Data Controller nor Data Processor because no personal data is transferred across the internet.
- **HIPAA Compliance:** Safe for medical records, patient photos, and radiological scans because no Protected Health Information (PHI) is transmitted or stored on cloud infrastructure.
- **Zero Third-Party Image Analytics:** No external tracking pixels, telemetry beacons, or ad networks have access to the canvas memory.
